notes: V7.1.11: properly fix the refresh wobble — the V7.1.1 fix only wrapped the kickoff, but bot-tab data updates happen asynchronously in _on_data; that's now where setUpdatesEnabled brackets the card mutations so Qt only repaints once per refresh. Plus a critical bug: a failure in any _apply_* helper used to strand every later section blank (RISK METRICS, API COST, POSITION MANAGEMENT). Each helper is now isolated in its own try/except so one bad piece of data can't blank out the whole tab. Also includes the server-side bot runner from Phase A of Step 5 (deploy to Oracle complete).
